name: Null Signal: Dispatches from the Stack
description: A pirate mesh broadcast that airs on irregular schedules from shifting node locations, Null Signal combines investigative reporting with practical instruction — episodes have covered how to identify corponation surveillance hardware, how to legally contest a debt-bonding contract using obscure Compact provisions, and how to treat augment-rejection syndrome without accessing licensed medical facilities. The host, known only as Threadline, has a calm, pedagogical delivery that makes the content feel like a community service rather than an act of defiance.
cultural_impact: Null Signal's practical self-sufficiency content has been credited by Shelf community organizers with meaningfully reducing preventable deaths in districts where the broadcasts have consistent reach.
story_hooks: The party is approached by someone claiming to be Threadline who needs protection — but the real Threadline has reached out through a separate channel saying they've been impersonated
Axiom's bounty hunters have triangulated Null Signal's broadcast node to within a two-block radius, and the party has hours to warn the operation before the sweep
A corporate operative has embedded themselves in Null Signal's listener network and is using it to identify and catalog Shelf residents who engage with anti-corponation content
